name: lolin-s2-mini
description: Wemos (Lolin) S2 Mini v1.0.0: ESP32-S2FH4 (4MB embedded flash, no PSRAM), single-core Xtensa LX7 240MHz, USB-C on native OTG. NOTE: this board has NO on-board LED of any kind - wire an external LED or WS2812 to any free GPIO. BOOT button on GPIO0; console on UART0 (TX GPIO43 / RX GPIO44) @115200.
